% Where the artifact lives. Single source of truth for all three builds.
%
% This is deliberately NOT in macros.tex: that file is generated by
% tools/paper_numbers.py from experimental records and is overwritten on every
% build, so a hand-edited locator would be silently destroyed.
%
% Both values below are placeholders until the deposit exists. The build scripts
% grep the RENDERED pdf for "PLACEHOLDER" and refuse to finish while either is
% still unfilled, because a dead or invented locator in an availability
% statement is worse than an absent one: it looks checkable and is not.
%
% TO FILL IN, once the Zenodo (or Figshare) deposit is created:
%   \fsArtifactDoi   the CONCEPT doi, which always resolves to the latest
%                    version, not the version-specific one
%   \fsArtifactAnon  a double-blind-safe mirror for ICLR. Zenodo restricted
%                    access or anonymous.4open.science both work; it must not
%                    carry the author's name, ORCID or institution.
\newcommand{\fsArtifactDoi}{PLACEHOLDER-ZENODO-CONCEPT-DOI}
\newcommand{\fsArtifactAnon}{PLACEHOLDER-ANONYMISED-MIRROR-URL}

% Upstream inputs, which are NOT this work's artifact and must not be conflated
% with it: the multi-head committee checkpoints and the 3BPA/water frames this
% work evaluates. Already public and pinned by hash in the release manifest.
\newcommand{\fsUpstreamZenodo}{10.5281/zenodo.17829635}
